items.title: American Bankers Association accuses OCC of undermining Congress with final stablecoin rewards rule
items.summary: The fight between banks and crypto has reignited after a top banking regulator declined to weigh in on third-party stablecoin rewards.

items.title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
items.summary: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.

items.title: SoFi Launches Tokenized Deposit That Earns 4.4% and Converts to a Stablecoin
items.summary: Each SOFIE token represents $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, earning 4.40% APY with FDIC insurance—a yield-and-protection combination ordinary stablecoins lack.

items.title: American Bankers Association: OCC’s GENIUS rules ‘undermine’ US Congress
items.summary: Banking advocacy organizations are pushing back against the OCC’s finalized rules on a stablecoin law, arguing against changes to provisions on yield.
